band_aid.definition: A temporary fix that makes a problem go away without solving it.
band_aid.example: We applied a band-aid to the payment process, but the real fix is in the accounting system.

notification_fatigue.definition: The habit of ignoring alerts on purpose, so that the one alert that mattered gets ignored too.
notification_fatigue.example: I turned off all notifications, and now nothing gets through, including the messages from my family.

trade.definition: To give one thing away and get a different thing back.
trade.example: I trade my ball for your dinosaur.

transfer.definition: A connection between two flights at the same airport, without going through the city in between.
transfer.example: I have a two-hour transfer in Singapore.
